contents.entry: Pointers: parent, siblings, schema, shared volumes
Input: any failure record (failure_body) and a start-grace expiry
Output records: attempt, regrant, dead and the failure.handled entity
Mechanism: the retry-owner rows and the backoff arithmetic
How it starts without an agent typing
Every wait, its timeout and its fallback
Retries of the retry node itself
Many agents at once: the collision answer
State paths written and the cleanup script for each

pointers.shared: Where this node goes live in the one cut-over order of the book

purpose.sentence: Every failure record routed here becomes exactly one action by the row of ../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner: a charged attempt n plus 1 after a backoff, a free regrant of the same attempt, a wait with one card, or, after the third charged failure of a phase, one dead record that the owner sees as one card; nothing loops and nothing is silent.
purpose.is: The owner of the seat-phase retry layer only (../../shared/retry-budget.xml#seat-attempt, #main-fix and #gate-phase): worker, reviewer and spec-author attempts and the free regrants. Inner layers (N-16 close-out, N-18 validator, N-24 pod ladder, N-25 plan attempts, N-01 store commits) retry their own failures and reach this node only when they give up (../../shared/retry-budget.xml#layers).
A table, not a judgement: failure_kind selects the row; the arithmetic is a pure function of n (Symphony SPEC.md lines 797 to 801).
purpose.is-not: Not a re-prompt of the same seat: session is new, or resume only where the row says resume-if-done (../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner).
Not an architect hop: the third failure is a dead record and one owner card (D11, D12).
purpose.decisions: D01, D02 (C36), D11 (C39), D12 (C40), D17 (C49), T02, V17 (standing policies carry the dead card's default).

record.field: Every value of ../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/failure_kind is accepted; the row of ../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner decides. Producers: stall (N-12), seat.bundle.failed (N-13), workspace.failed, workspace.refused, cap (N-14), crashed, no_result, schema_invalid, output_rejected, seat_blocked, error_max_turns, error_max_budget, harness_mismatch (N-15 seat.result), phase.failed (N-16, N-17 and N-19 close-out after its own three tries), review.changes (N-19), gate.red (N-08), merge.conflict (N-09), claim_overlap and files-claimed (N-03 at ready), admission-refused (N-24).

field.name: ticket, phase, attempt, outcome, run_id, dispatch_id

record.field: true on a seat.result or phase.failed accepted under ../../shared/contracts.xml#terminal-report: an echo of a failure already charged by the stall or expiry path. It is marked handled with action echo and changes no ticket status.
Copied as detail into the next brief by N-13 (review findings, red suites, conflict base, stall reason, failing acceptance command).

start-grace: a reserved lease never started (../../shared/contracts.xml#lease-machine Sweep row); a free regrant, no attempt charged. end_reason expired on a running lease is acted on through N-12's stall record, not here.

input.starts-when: A failure record is committed. Level-triggered as well: each scheduler tick lists failure records with no failure.handled:FAILURE_ID entity and starts a traversal for each, so a lost traversal is caught within one tick.

record.field: attempt n plus 1 (2 or 3). After review.changes, gate.red or merge.conflict the phase is worker. Operation key N-11/attempt/TICKET:PHASE:N/r1 with N the new attempt.
now plus min(10 x 2^(n-1), retry.backoff_max_seconds) plus jitter (../../shared/retry-budget.xml#d-backoff); jitter is passed in so tests pass zero.
new, or resume with the prior worker session id when the row is resume-if-done and that run ended done.
The failures this attempt answers; N-13 attaches each to the brief.
record.note: Same Commit: statement attempts.append, statement tickets.transition in_flight or pr_open to retry_wait (claims keep), entity failure.handled:FAILURE_ID with precondition absent. When not_before passes N-03 moves retry_wait to ready and N-07 grants the new key.

record.field: A free regrant of the same attempt: workspace.refused, claim_overlap and files-claimed after retry.claim_seconds; cap on the next tick; a start-grace expiry at once. Operation key N-11/regrant/LEASE_KEY@TOKEN/r1, which is what lets GrantDispatch re-grant that key (../../shared/contracts.xml#lease-machine).
record.note: Same Commit: tickets.transition in_flight to ready (claims keep) and entity failure.handled:FAILURE_ID.

record.field: The charged failures with ids and kinds, so the card reads once.
owner_acts true; the recommendation from the table below; the standing policy row when one exists (V17).
record.note: Same Commit: tickets.transition to dead, claims.release, entity failure.handled:FAILURE_ID. Operation key N-11/attempt/TICKET:PHASE:N/r1 with N the attempt that would have followed (4 after exhaustion), so a dead and an attempt for one slot cannot both commit.

record.field: attempt, regrant, dead, echo (fenced) or not_mine (a row whose owner is another node: phase.failed before its owner gave up, admission-refused). Replaces the handled_by field of book 1.0.0: records are never edited.

output.ends-when: The failure.handled entity exists for the failure; the traversal is over.

mechanism.where: Go package retry inside the service; Next(failure, history, now, jitterFraction) returns one intent; the engine sends it as one Store.Do (../../shared/contracts.xml#batch).
mechanism.step: Load the attempts rows for the ticket and phase and the ticket row. n equals the failed attempt.
fenced true: write only failure.handled with action echo; end. The kill that fenced the run was already charged (../../shared/contracts.xml#terminal-report).
Select the row of ../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner by failure_kind. The table below adds only what is this node's: the recommendation on a dead card and the session rule applied.

row.recommendation: system-lane fault, or raise the role's stall bound

row.policy: POL-blocked-land-it (factory/config/policies.json), deadline 1800 s, default: land on the criteria as written

row.action: charge once (the owner N-16, N-17 or N-19 already spent its three close-out tries)
charge the worker phase: the worker merges main into its branch; never a repeated merge
row.recommendation: a third conflict is a scheduling defect (memory one-file-one-in-flight-ticket)

row.action: wait, free: the ticket waits with one card until the harness pin matches
row.recommendation: update the pin or the harness

row.action: not_mine (N-24 owns it: defect record and one card)

mechanism.step: Charge with n below 3: attempt n plus 1. Charge with n equal to 3: dead. Regrant: regrant record. Wait: failure.handled with action not_mine and the card is N-15's harness_mismatch record (see the gap noted in many-agents). The gate phase is never re-dispatched after N-25 gave up (../../shared/retry-budget.xml#gate-phase): a gate.red charges the worker, never the gate.

Fix tickets for one red main are bounded by ../../shared/retry-budget.xml#main-fix, a layer this node owns: each fix ticket carries the red main sha in its source request; when the bound's last fix ticket goes dead, its dead record carries recommendation system-lane-fault and N-10 cuts no further fix for that sha. Each fix ticket also has its own seat attempts and the per-ticket budget N-07 enforces.

One Commit per intent with its operation key, the statements of the output section, and failure.handled:FAILURE_ID with precondition absent; 409 on that entity means another traversal already acted, which is read back and ends this one.
mechanism.invariant: One attempt per (ticket, phase, n plus 1), one dead per (ticket, phase); never a fourth attempt (K10).
backoff(n) equals min(10 x 2^(n-1), retry.backoff_max_seconds) seconds.
mechanism.diagram: flowchart TD F["failure record with failure_body"] --> H{"failure.handled exists?"} H -- yes --> E["end"] H -- no --> X{"fenced?"} X -- yes --> EC["failure.handled echo"] X -- no --> T["retry-owner row"] T -- charge, n below 3 --> A["attempt n+1, retry_wait, not_before"] T -- charge, n = 3 --> D["dead, claims released, one card"] T -- free --> R["regrant: in_flight to ready"] T -- other owner --> NM["failure.handled not_mine"]

start.sentence: Nothing here starts by an agent typing.
start.by: The commit of a failure record starts a traversal; the scheduler tick lists failures with no failure.handled entity and starts the missing traversals.
start.restart: A traversal that died before its Commit left nothing; the tick re-runs it, and the operation key makes a Commit that did land a replay.

wait.fallback: resend with the same operation key 1 s, 2 s, 4 s; then retry.write.failed 500 once per failure id and the next tick retries

wait.on: not_before passing before the ticket returns to ready
wait.timeout: min(10 x 2^(n-1), retry.backoff_max_seconds) s plus jitter
wait.fallback: none needed: a timestamp in the store, not a sleep

wait.on: the owner answering a dead card
wait.timeout: the standing policy's deadline when the failure kind has a row (1800 s for seat_blocked), else none
wait.fallback: the policy default is applied by N-29's rule and recorded as a ruling; a kind with no row stays dead with its card up; the line runs on

waits.rule: No sleep in this node; every backoff is a not_before timestamp.

step.name: Commit
step.backoff: 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, same operation key
step.then: retry.write.failed 500 once per failure id; the next tick re-runs the traversal

retries.not-retried: A dead record is never retried by the system; only an owner ruling (N-29) moves dead to waiting and resets the attempt counter (../../shared/contracts.xml#ticket-transitions).
retries.report: Every then clause is a record; the dead record carries the whole history so the card is one read.

many-agents.readers: Any seat reads attempt and dead records; a brief for attempt n plus 1 carries the failures by id.
many-agents.two-traversals: Two traversals for one failure both Commit failure.handled:FAILURE_ID with precondition absent; one wins, the loser gets 409 version and ends.
many-agents.two-failures: Two failures for one attempt (review.changes and gate.red on one head) both select attempt n plus 1; the operation key N-11/attempt/TICKET:PHASE:N makes the second a replay or 409 idempotency_mismatch; the loser reads the attempt back and Commits its own failure.handled pointing at it, so one attempt answers both. A stall and the fenced seat.result of the same run cannot double-charge: the second is an echo.
many-agents.harness-gap: harness_mismatch: ../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner says the ticket goes to waiting, but #ticket-transitions has no in_flight to waiting row; until the contracts volume adds it (owner N-11), this node writes only failure.handled not_mine and N-07 refuses to grant while the pin differs. Reported as an open item.
many-agents.conflict-reports: Every refused Commit is logged with its operation key and counted; never a silent overwrite.

emits.acts: N-03 moves retry_wait to ready at not_before; N-07 grants the new key
N-07 grants the same attempt again
owner-acts: N-28 one card; N-41 alerts; N-29's ruling is the only way back

consumes.kinds: every record carrying failure_body; lease.expired start-grace

state-paths.root: $COQ_STATE as in ../N-07/spec.xml#state-paths; path elements in N-45's generator form.
state-paths.path: Rows: attempt, regrant and dead records, the attempts table, failure.handled entities. Dead records of tickets with no ruling are never pruned.
One line per decision with n, backoff and the operation key.

repo-file.planned: created by the N-11 build ticket; not on main yet

state-paths.repo-file: The recommendation and policy columns of m-retry-table; the charge and session columns are read from the contracts rows, never restated.
state-paths.never: No file under the repository at run time; no counter in memory (the store holds n).

re-entry.as: ticket retry_wait to ready, then a GrantDispatch of the new key
re-entry.bound: 3 attempts then dead and one escalation

re-entry-in.record: ruling that unblocks a dead ticket
re-entry-in.note: dead to waiting; attempt resets to 1

schema.defs: failure (committed envelope plus ../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/failure_body), attempt, regrant, dead, failure_handled; lease_expired is ../N-02's.

checklist.item: The arithmetic is min(10 x 2^(n-1), cap) s.

item.proof: test TestThreeThenDead: three charged failures write attempts 2 and 3 then one dead

checklist.item: Three attempts then dead, never a fourth.

item.proof: test TestEveryFailureKind iterates contracts.schema.json failure_kind and asserts one action per value, equal to the retry-owner row's charges and session

checklist.item: Every failure kind has a row.

item.proof: test TestFencedEcho: a stall then a fenced seat.result for the same run write one attempt and one echo

checklist.item: A fenced report never charges twice.
Two failures on one attempt yield one attempt record.

item.proof: test TestFreeRegrant: workspace.refused, claim_overlap, files-claimed, cap and a start-grace expiry write regrant and no attempt
test TestMergeConflictToWorker: merge.conflict writes worker attempt n+1, never a merge retry

checklist.item: A conflict goes back to the worker.

item.proof: N-28 test TestOneCardPerDead with two dead commits for one key posts one card
grep of internal/retry finds no time.Sleep

checklist.item: Backoff is a timestamp, not a sleep.

item.proof: config key retry.enabled false until the go-live ticket; while false failures accumulate unhandled and N-41 shows them

permissions.process: The Go service, principal coq-svc acting as N-11 (../../shared/authority.xml#role-derivation).
permissions.reads: failure records, the attempts and tickets tables, the policies table.
permissions.writes: attempt, regrant, dead, retry.write.failed, store.unreachable records; statements attempts.append, tickets.transition, claims.release; failure.handled entities; the retry log.
permissions.never: No grant (N-07 does that), no prompt, no pane, no GitHub, no edit of any record once written.
permissions.seat: A seat has no store socket (../../shared/authority.xml#seat-isolation); a seat that wants another try posts its result and leaves.

gauge.name: failures_unhandled
gauge.from: failure records with no failure.handled entity older than one tick

lamp.name: retry
lamp.red: failures_unhandled above 0 for three ticks, or retry.write.failed open

runbook.bring-up: factory/config/retry.json present and lint-green; set retry.enabled true; proof: a failure record, its failure.handled entity and its attempt record.
runbook.read-status: Scheduler.Status lists tickets in retry_wait with their not_before, dead tickets with their recommendation and whether a card is up; the Alerts screen shows dead_open.
runbook.unblock-dead: Only a ruling on the card (N-29) moves a dead ticket; the Scheduler.Retry RPC runs under that ruling's id and never by hand.
runbook.change-a-bound: Edit factory/config/retry.json through a ticket; Scheduler.Reload loads it; no restart.
runbook.registry: Generated into shared/cleanup-registry.json from the state-paths element (../N-45/spec.xml#state-paths).
